name: lullsense
title_zh: 婴儿夜醒先问白天小睡再答的睡眠顾问
tagline_zh: 4-36个月娃早醒、拒睡、夜醒、短觉，先聊就值；有睡眠日志还能看趋势。不贩卖焦虑，只给循证建议。
tagline_en: For 4–36mo sleep struggles—early wakes, bedtime fights, short naps. Conversation alone helps; add a log for trend.
desc_en: LullSense (知眠) helps parents of babies and toddlers (roughly 4–36 months) understand child sleep through evidence-informed conversation, with optional longitudinal pattern detection when a sleep log is available. Use whenever a caregiver raises a child sleep concern — e.g. early waking, bedtime resistance, night waking, short naps, or "is this normal?". Gives real value from conversation alone (no
why_zh: 先问清白天小睡、入睡时机等上下文再开口，避免一刀切；没日志也能靠对话给真建议，不是只会要数据。
why_en: Asks about naps and timing before advising—no one-size-fits-all. Works from conversation alone; logs add longitudinal insight.
limit_zh: 只覆盖4-36个月婴幼儿睡眠；不诊断疾病（如呼吸问题、胃食管反流），也不替代医生。无日志时不做趋势判断，只给当下建议。
limit_en: Only for ages 4–36 months. Does not diagnose medical conditions (e.g., breathing, reflux) or replace a pediatrician. Without a sleep log, no trend.
title_en: Baby sleep advisor that checks naps before answering
